business.phoneNote: Read off the Google Business Profile for THE LOST+UNFOUNDS on 30 August 2026, in the profile's own display format, because the GBP and this site's JSON-LD are the two halves of one NAP and Google reconciles them. Do not reformat it and do not substitute a call-tracking number — tracking is handled by dynamic number insertion via analytics.phoneLinkClass, which swaps the displayed number while this one stays canonical.

quoteForm.actionNote: The platform's own endpoint. It takes an ordinary form-encoded POST and answers 303 to redirectPath, which needs no CORS header — a plain form post is a CORS simple request. Leads land in microsite_leads, not bookings: bookings.event_date is NOT NULL and a quote request has no date.
quoteForm.turnstileNote: Public site key, the same widget the main site uses; the secret lives only in TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY on the server. BEFORE LAUNCH: add austinairbnbphotography.com to this widget's domain list in the Cloudflare dashboard, or every submission from the real domain fails the check.
